final_response_fingerprint.details: Read-only independent review (no cargo, no edits to source, no git writes) of OpenSpec change scope-hindsight-memory-per-world. Files: scratch/applyall/manifest-hindsight.txt lists the uncommitted files; use `git diff` and read the new files crates/jcode-config-types/src/hindsight.rs, crates/jcode-base/src/hindsight_memory_scope.rs (+_tests.rs). Compare against openspec/changes/scope-hindsight-memory-per-world/{proposal,design,tasks}.md and specs. First, IMMEDIATELY append to scratch/applyall/review-hindsight.md (it has a skeleton) and keep appending findings incrementally every few minutes, never only at the end, because server reloads kill workers. Check: (1) cross-world leakage: every recall/retain path must carry the world scope and fail closed when scope is unresolved; (2) the Hindsight HTTP contract pinned in task 1.1 is from primary sources or an explicit fail-closed blocker is recorded; (3) no network to real Hindsight in tests; (4) config trust: project-local config cannot widen scope; (5) tasks.md boxes backed by evidence. Classify findings blocker/major/minor with file:line. End with a line `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes-requested` and `REVIEW COMPLETE`.
